crossRefs.note: Lord, I beg you, let your ear be attentive now to the prayer of your servant, and to the prayer of your servants, who…
He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.
When a man’s ways please Yahweh, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

translations.web: I will grant you mercy, that he may have mercy on you, and cause you to return to your own land.
translations.bsb: And I will show you compassion, and he will have compassion on you and restore you to your own land.’
translations.kjv: And I will shew mercies unto you, that he may have mercy upon you, and cause you to return to your own land.
translations.asv: And I will grant you mercy, that he may have mercy upon you, and cause you to return to your own land.
